mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.status='active' AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND ur.scope_type='model_registry' AND ur.scope_id=mv.model_key)

SELECT mv.id,mv.model_key,mv.version,mv.task_type,mv.manifest_version,CAST(mv.manifest_json AS CHAR) manifest_json,mv.artifact_ref,mv.artifact_sha256,mv.feature_contract_version,mv.approval_status,mv.created_at FROM model_version mv
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_version mv WHERE
WHERE ORDER BY mv.created_at DESC,mv.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id FROM model_version WHERE model_key=#{modelKey} AND version=#{version}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_release_record WHERE model_version_id=#{modelId} AND review_status='pending'
SELECT id FROM model_release_record WHERE model_version_id=#{modelId} AND requested_by=#{requestedBy} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT rr.id,rr.model_version_id,rr.review_status,rr.requested_by,rr.approved_by,rr.release_status,mv.model_key FROM model_release_record rr JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=rr.model_version_id WHERE rr.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE model_release_record SET release_status='approved' WHERE id=#{id} AND review_status='approved' AND approved_by=#{actorId} AND release_status='validated'

UPDATE model_release_record rr JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=rr.model_version_id SET rr.review_status=#{status},rr.approved_by=#{actorId},rr.decision_reason=#{reason},rr.reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),rr.release_status=CASE WHEN #{status}='approved' THEN 'approved' ELSE rr.release_status END,mv.approval_status=CASE WHEN #{status}='approved' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END WHERE rr.id=#{id} AND rr.review_status='pending' AND rr.requested_by<>#{actorId} AND mv.approval_status='validated' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE u.id=#{actorId} AND u.status='active' AND p.permission_key='model.release.approve' AND ur.scope_type='model_registry' AND ur.scope_id=mv.model_key)
UPDATE model_version SET approval_status='validated' WHERE id=#{id} AND approval_status='candidate' AND artifact_sha256=#{sha256}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_release_record WHERE model_version_id=#{modelId} AND review_status='approved' AND release_status IN ('approved','active','retired')
SELECT id FROM model_deployment WHERE environment='local' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE model_deployment SET status='inactive' WHERE environment='local' AND status='active'
UPDATE model_release_record SET release_status='retired' WHERE release_status='active' AND model_version_id<>#{modelId}

UPDATE model_release_record SET release_status='active',released_by=#{actorId},released_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE model_version_id=#{modelId} AND review_status='approved' AND release_status IN ('approved','retired')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.status='active' AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND ur.scope_type='model_registry' AND ur.scope_id=#{modelKey})
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND scope_type='model_registry' AND scope_id=#{modelKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM model_lifecycle_lock WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT model_version_id FROM model_deployment WHERE environment='local' AND status='active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.model_version_id FROM model_deployment d JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=d.model_version_id WHERE d.environment='local' AND d.status='inactive' AND d.model_version_id<>#{currentId} AND mv.model_key=#{modelKey} AND mv.approval_status='approved' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_release_record rr WHERE rr.model_version_id=mv.id AND rr.review_status='approved') ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE model_version mv SET approval_status='retired',retired_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), retired_by=#{actor},retire_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{modelId} AND approval_status<>'retired' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_deployment d WHERE d.model_version_id=mv.id AND d.status='active') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_release_record rr WHERE rr.model_version_id=mv.id AND rr.review_status='pending')
